matches.rationale: No finding addresses the Abstract overstatement about compression and adversarial accuracy; the findings do not mention the Abstract or its claims.
Pred_id 1 identifies a mismatch between Proposition 2 and its proof in Appendix C, directly corresponding to the intended corruption that weakens or incorrectly interprets the condition number bound.
No finding reports omitted hyperparameter details (beta tuning, learning rate schedules, augmentation strategies); the findings cover other experimental issues.
No finding mentions the Conclusion or the overstatement of surpassing literature by a large margin; the findings do not cover rhetorical exaggeration in the Conclusion.
No finding reports fabricated citations, misattributed references, or inaccurate dataset descriptions in Related Work.
No finding notes the omission of ethical implications or risks in the discussion of adversarial robustness improvements.
No finding identifies promotional tone or exaggerated certainty in the Introduction; the findings focus on equations, data, and experimental design.
No finding addresses the method-level inconsistency between the assumption of orthogonal U, V and the algorithmic steps that destroy orthogonality.
Pred_ids 4 and 5 expose figure‑table mismatches in clean accuracy, which are concrete symptoms of the data integrity issue (manipulated table numbers) described in the ground truth.
No finding captures the exaggerated interpretation ('almost doubles', 'significantly outperforms') in the text describing Mixup attack results.
Pred_id 3 reports that the adversarial training comparison in Table 6 is confounded because baseline and DLRT did not use adversarial batches, matching the asymmetric exposure ground truth exactly.
No finding questions the 3% training time overhead or the benchmarking methodology for computational cost.
No finding points out the incoherence between the Abstract's claim of being model‑/data‑agnostic and the method's restriction to Tucker factorization.
No finding discusses the missing ethical statements in the Acknowledgments / Appendix section.
